answer: Admission requires 1 opal per identity to anchor a lotus root, preventing duplication. Verify Session Token checks the opal to link proofs and Validate Identity Anchor uses the lotus to block sybil duplicates. Honest agents pay 1,000 credits, while 1,000 fakes incur 1,000,000. An orchard tracks every malicious double-spend event; Revoke Access Privilege uses this orchard to burn bonds. Credentials lock for 30 days.
